reasons.c.integration: The Rust integration harness, its shared test support, c/Dockerfile.grpc and c/grpc_server/CMakeLists.txt changed.
reasons.c.unit: c/CMakeLists.txt changed how the Rust library is found, c/Makefile changed, and every C test file changed (a new test_filter.h was added).

reasons.dotnet.solution: Confluent.Kafka.csproj changed how the native library is copied, dotnet/Makefile changed, and a unit test file changed.

reasons.python.integration: setup.py and python/Makefile changed how the extension is built.

reasons.rust.consumer: The build profile and the shared test support in rust/tests/common changed.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: The workspace Cargo.toml profile change rebuilds this package's tests.
reasons.rust.doc: The workspace Cargo.toml changed, and that reaches the doctests.
reasons.rust.ffi-macros: The workspace Cargo.toml profile change rebuilds this package's tests.
reasons.rust.generator: The workspace Cargo.toml profile change rebuilds this package's tests.
reasons.rust.integration: The build profile, the shared test support in rust/tests/common and plaintext_consumer_poll_test.rs changed.
reasons.rust.integrity: The build profile and the shared test support in rust/tests/common changed.
reasons.rust.lib: rust/Cargo.toml changed the test profile that the unit tests are built with.
reasons.rust.multilanguage-test-server: The workspace build profile and the multilanguage test macros changed.
reasons.rust.performance: rust/tests/performance/main.rs and the build profile changed.
reasons.rust.producer: The build profile and the shared test support in rust/tests/common changed.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: The workspace Cargo.toml profile change rebuilds this package's tests.
